# Verify heapObjectsCanMove reports the selected moving mode (M19-S5).
# The tiny program linknames runtime.heapObjectsCanMove, the exported
# runtime API (src/runtime/mgc.go) backed by logosHeapObjectsCanMove
# (src/runtime/logos_move.go); there is no wrapper in src/logos/rt.
# (a) default build: false. (b) GOEXPERIMENT=logosgcmoving with
# -ldflags=-X=runtime.logosGCMode=immix: true. (c) same with zgc: true.
# Raw -X bypasses the closed -gc=immix/-gc=zgc command gate, the way
# buildLogosMove links the mode; env handling follows logos_gc_mode.txt
# and logos_pacer_selection.txt.

[!GOARCH:amd64] [!GOARCH:arm64] skip 'GOEXPERIMENT=logosgcmoving moving modes need amd64 or arm64'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# (a) default build (no experiment): heap objects cannot move.
env GOEXPERIMENT=
go build -o $WORK/bin/canmove_default$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/bin/canmove_default$GOEXE
cmp stdout expect_false.txt

# (b) immix moving mode: heap objects can move.
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosgcmoving
go build -ldflags=-X=runtime.logosGCMode=immix -o $WORK/bin/canmove_immix$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/bin/canmove_immix$GOEXE
cmp stdout expect_true.txt

# (c) zgc moving mode: heap objects can move.
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosgcmoving
go build -ldflags=-X=runtime.logosGCMode=zgc -o $WORK/bin/canmove_zgc$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/bin/canmove_zgc$GOEXE
cmp stdout expect_true.txt

-- expect_false.txt --
false
-- expect_true.txt --
true
-- go.mod --
module example.com/movecanmove

go 1.27

-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	_ "unsafe"
)

//go:linkname heapObjectsCanMove runtime.heapObjectsCanMove
func heapObjectsCanMove() bool

func main() {
	fmt.Println(heapObjectsCanMove())
}
